precompile_equivalence.statement: For the current additive B434/B435 model, quotient-aware beam on raw groups produces the same distinct objective-vector beam result as B435 beam on B455-precompiled groups, at the same width.
proof_sketch: B455 scale reference is used directly, so scalar normalization matches the precompiled pipeline.
Unsafe raw options never enter either pipeline.

Locally dominated same-signature options are removed by B455 before expansion, and by lossless prefix Pareto pruning after raw expansion; a dominating option has no greater resident use, so feasibility cannot make the dominated option uniquely survive.
Exact same-signature ties are canonicalized before truncation in both pipelines.
Different semantic signatures are retained in both pipelines.
By induction over prefix depth, the same canonical decision states reach each truncation step.
